cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

mechanism: Copy allergy ticks as sales records, then investigate the actual ranking metric, reward and comparative totals.
confusable: Not generic competitiveness: B2 must reveal a misunderstood copied mark and A3 must hide that gap while asking how rewards work.
comparison: Stall earnings and fee accounting differ from election votes and a supporter's interest.
seedUse: Uses picnic success/ranking seed but replaces the unintroduced last-year clipboard with explicit fundraiser totals.
